name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 3 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2026-06-14, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 3.51 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
